Autumn note for a special handover
Please take a moment
Travelers, please check your pet travel details before you arrive.

Autumn travel notice for pets

We are sorry for any confusion, and we want your trip to stay calm and simple. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is reviewing each animal handover with extra care, so please follow the guidance given at check-in and keep your documents ready. <<FACT F070>>

Our handlers use gentle steps and clear notes so animals are moved with as little stress as possible. <<FACT F057>> If your plans change, let the desk know right away so we can help you sort things out without delay.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for the latest help and a smooth handover.
